Update your box

Update in three steps.

Plug the box into a computer, press one button, wait. Nothing to download and no account to make.

You need

  • A laptop or desktop with Chrome or Edge. Phones, tablets, Firefox and Safari won't work.
  • A data cable (USB-C). Charging-only cables look the same and won't connect.
This browser can't talk to the box. Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer and the button will be here. This page has to be opened over a secure connection for the button to work.

There's nothing new to put on it right now. When there is, the button turns up here on its own.

0%

  1. 1
    Plug it in Box to computer with the data cable. The screen should light up.
  2. 2
    Press Update my box Pick your box from the list. If it isn't there, unplug it, plug it back in, and try again.
  3. 3
    Wait for the bar Don't unplug it while the bar is filling. The box restarts by itself when it's done.
Something still wrong after updating?

Touch off, or taps going to the wrong place? Fix touch on your box walks you through it. It has a reset that always works.

What an update actually does

It puts the newest version of the game on the box, and it takes a few seconds. Your brightness, your theme, your tips switch and your lock setting go back to how they came, so pick those again afterwards. Nothing else on the box is yours to lose: it keeps no scores, no names and no saved games.

If nothing happens

Try a different cable first, that's nearly always what it is. Then try the other socket on the computer. If the window opens but the box isn't in the list, the cable you're using only carries power.
